messages:
aria (arch): heads-up — starting a discussion on the soft-gatekeeper rollout thresholds for the legacy-to-new API shim. want a short, operational playbook we can hand to oncall and platform teams.

mike (eng-platform): love it. are we aiming for percentage-based canaries (e.g. 1/5/25/100) or signal-driven (error/latency/validation-mismatch)?

aria (arch): leaning signal-driven with percentage caps. example: start at 0.5% traffic, expand only when signals are green. main signals: 5xx rate, p95 latency delta, and payload validation failures.

sam (eng-infra): question: how do we handle noise on validation failures? some clients send slightly different envelopes; we don't want false rollbacks.

jess (sre): +1. need hysteresis and rate-normalization. i suggest thresholds based on relative increase vs baseline (e.g., +50% above baseline) and require sustained window (5m-15m) before action.

mike (eng-platform): propose concrete thresholds: 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute OR 5xx relative increase > 100% sustained for 10m. p95 latency increase > 50% or +200ms absolute for 10m. validation failures > 0.2% absolute AND 2x baseline. only escalate if combined signals >= 2.

aria (arch): that feels reasonable. also want an automated rollback trigger that flips the gate to 0% if critical thresholds hit, with a cooldown and notification.

sam (eng-infra): we can add a soft-stop that reduces traffic to 1% (instead of full rollback) for investigation, then auto-escalate to full rollback if deterioration continues. safer for noisy metrics.

jess (sre): include a mandatory human-in-the-loop step for model-output-regression alerts. if quality checks (prompt evals) fail, we do immediate rollback and pager.

mike (eng-platform): ok, draft playbook flow: 1) release to internal tenants 2) 0.5% auto-canary 3) observe signals for 30m 4) bump to 5% if green 5) bump to 25% then 100% if green. at each step evaluate signals and run quick synthetic checks.

aria (arch): add a pre-flight checklist: - confirm telemetry tag present (gate=soft-v2) - ensure embargoed-tenants excluded - smoke test suite pass - alerting runbooks linked.

sam (eng-infra): sample gate config we can use in rollout automation: ```gate: soft-v2steps: [ {pct:0.5, min_duration:30m}, {pct:5, min_duration:60m}, {pct:25, min_duration:120m}, {pct:100, min_duration:0m} ]signals: {5xx_abs:0.005,5xx_rel:2.0,p95_ms:200,validation_rel:2.0,validation_abs:0.002}actions: {auto_reduce_to:1,auto_rollback:true,notify:#oncall} ```

jess (sre): nice. add an interactive command for oncall: `/gate-status soft-v2` should return current pct, recent signal windows, and last action.

mike (eng-platform): we can implement that in the feature-flag service. also add telemetry dimensions so we can attribute errors to shim codepath: header x-shim-version and metric tag shim_gate=soft-v2.

aria (arch): what about client-side compatibility mismatches (payload shape changes)? if validation failures are primarily schema rejects we should route to a fallback translator sidecar rather than rollback.

sam (eng-infra): agree. fallback translator path is cheaper than full rollback for a while. decision logic: if validation failures > threshold and 90% of failures are parse errors -> lower traffic and route to translator. otherwise rollback.

jess (sre): runbook excerpt for oncall: 1) check `/gate-status` 2) run `curl` smoke tests hitting both shim and fallback 3) if metric breach, run `gate set soft-v2 pct 1` and notify platform oncall 4) if continued breach after 30m, `gate rollback soft-v2` and page owners.

mike (eng-platform): can we add a short cooldown and automated postmortem stub when rollback occurs? deployer-bot could create a postmortem draft with telemetry snapshot.

deployer-bot: created incident draft IR-1795123456-soft-gatekeeper-rollback with tags [soft-gatekeeper, auto-rollback].

aria (arch): perfect. last bit: telemetry retention for these gate metrics should be 90d so we can analyze migration cohorts. also capture tenant id, region, and client-sdk-version.

sam (eng-infra): will add tags and bump retention for the gate namespace. i'll open infra PR and link it here.

mike (eng-platform): i'll sketch the rollout automation and CLI hooks. expect a PR early next week.

jess (sre): add me as escalation contact in the playbook and run simulated failure drills during the next oncall rotation. :drill:

aria (arch): thanks everyone — i'll turn this into a short runbook doc and a concise ops checklist. tagging owners: @mike @sam @jess.

mike (eng-platform): thanks, will follow up with the PR link when ready.

sam (eng-infra): PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/soft-gate-retention - includes metric tags and retention changes.

jess (sre): noted. closing the thread once runbook is in Docs.

aria (arch): closing: next steps: mike PR for automation, sam infra PR, jess run drills, aria to author runbook. timeline: aim to have dry-run in 2 weeks.
